title: Plugin resource card
responsibility: Shows one resource type of a plugin with the steps to make one and the generate command.

inputs.name: PluginResourceCard.entry
inputs.description: The module entry supplies definition.id for the generate command and installed for the command label. This component does not read its source, instances, or other definition fields.

definition.title: Components
definition.description: Components used by this project's code.
instructions: Included from the start. Browse Components through Code; existing addresses and source identities are preserved.
Generate a component through this module and use --group for its responsibility category.

resources.title: Components
instructions: Use the existing Harness scaffold rules, implement the declared responsibility and run the generated tests.

inputs.name: PluginResourceCard.resource
inputs.description: The module resource supplies instructions for PluginSteps and id for the generate command. The card does not read its other resource fields.

examples.title: Components
instructions: Use the existing Harness scaffold rules, implement the declared responsibility and run the generated tests.

inputs.name: PluginResourceCard.title
inputs.description: The snippet renders the card heading. The component calls it once and does not construct or link its contents.

outputs.name: PluginResourceCard
outputs.description: The rendered card contains the heading snippet, instruction steps, and a generate command block. The command is harness plugin generate <entry.definition.id> <resource.id> Example; its label is Generate when entry.installed is true and Generate, once installed otherwise.
